question: What will the first reported earnings per share after September 2026 be for the following companies? (SpaceX)

calls.reasoning: Q2 2026 GAAP EPS was -0.09 (net loss $541M on 5.86B weighted shares, adj EBITDA $3.54B), beating the -0.26 consensus. Q3 is the first full post-IPO quarter, with roughly double the share count, Cursor consolidated from Aug 14, and the Anthropic cloud deal fully ramped. UBS sees adj EBITDA of $7.5B on $13.8B revenue. Aggregator consensus is ~0.13-0.14 (range -0.11 to 0.29); MarketBeat shows 0.00. A rough bottom-up estimate (EBITDA minus D&A, interest, tax and stock comp on ~12.5-13B shares) gives ~0.10-0.12. The median is shaded slightly below consensus for Cursor amortization/SBC and the GAAP-vs-adjusted ambiguity, and kept wide for investment mark-to-market swings. No Kalshi/Polymarket/Manifold EPS market found.
